consequence.statement: ApplicationSet generators using GitLab SCM provider with HasPath search will handle 404 HTTP responses differently, treating them as file-not-found rather than errors.

original.statement: GitLab SCM HasPath search behavior is reverted and 404 errors are now treated as file-not-found in ApplicationSet generators.

decision.reason: [ev-dc295e9fc56b] is a changelog bugfix entry. It says the ApplicationSet GitLab SCM HasPath search was reverted and that 404 errors are now treated as file not found. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so no failure kind is supported. A changed runtime behaviour that keeps working fits behavior-change, which means review. The proposed statement reads the one-line entry closely enough, but because the evidence does not spell out the operator impact, confidence is low.
